newsitem.title: USA: UST has "no information" on Philip Morris report.
newsitem.headline: UST has "no information" on Philip Morris report.

text.p: UST Inc said it had "no information" on a report that Philip Morris Cos Inc was planning to buy the company.
The Delaney Report, a weekly marketing newsletter, reported in its March 24 issue that Philip Morris was getting ready to make a tender offer for UST.
"We have no information that would confirm the information in the Delaney Report," a spokesman said. Philip Morris officials were not immediately available for comment.
Philip Morris shares rose 2-3/8 to 118-1/4, while UST fell 7/8 to 29-1/4.
